title: A Day in London
text: Yesterday, Sarah went to London with her friends. They travelled by train and arrived at 10 AM. First, they visited the British Museum, which was very interesting. Then, they ate lunch in a small restaurant near Covent Garden. In the afternoon, they walked along the River Thames and took many photos of Big Ben. They returned home late, tired but very happy.

title: The Importance of Sleep
text: Getting enough sleep is crucial for maintaining good physical and mental health. Studies show that adults need between seven and nine hours of sleep per night to function optimally. During sleep, the body repairs tissues, builds muscle, and strengthens the immune system. Furthermore, adequate rest improves memory consolidation and cognitive performance. People who consistently lack sleep are at a higher risk of developing conditions such as obesity, diabetes, and cardiovascular disease.

title: The Rise of Artificial Intelligence
text: Artificial Intelligence (AI) has rapidly transitioned from science fiction to everyday reality. Machine learning algorithms now power everything from personalized recommendations on streaming platforms to advanced diagnostic tools in modern medicine. While proponents argue that AI will revolutionize industries by increasing efficiency and reducing human error, critics raise significant ethical concerns. The potential for widespread job displacement and the challenge of algorithmic bias are among the most pressing issues. As technology continues to evolve at an unprecedented pace, establishing robust regulatory frameworks will be essential to mitigate these risks.

questions.question: According to critics, what is a major concern regarding AI?
What is suggested as a solution to mitigate AI risks?

title: The Economics of Globalization
text: Globalization has fundamentally reshaped the architecture of the global economy, fostering unprecedented levels of interconnectedness. The reduction of trade barriers and the advent of sophisticated logistics networks have enabled multinational corporations to optimize their supply chains on a planetary scale. Consequently, consumers in developed nations have benefited from a ubiquitous array of affordable goods. However, this economic paradigm is not without its detractors. The outsourcing of manufacturing has hollowed out industrial heartlands in many Western countries, leading to wage stagnation and exacerbating socioeconomic inequality. Furthermore, the relentless pursuit of economic growth often exacts a severe toll on the environment.

questions.question: What has enabled the optimization of supply chains?
options: Reduction of trade barriers and sophisticated logistics
